name: DS Cluster S46: Asset Spec (Tick Size, Multiplier, Class)
description: Tests: asset_spec() for min_tick, multiplier, asset_class, name, exchange. Dynamic tick conversion, contract value calculation, cross-sectional asset metadata in cards.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S46: Asset Spec
# Tests: asset_spec() metadata lookup, tick conversion, notional
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === ASSET SPEC LOOKUP ===
spec = asset_spec()
tick = spec.min_tick
multiplier = spec.multiplier

# === DYNAMIC TICK CONVERSION ===
raw_move = close - src.o
move_in_ticks = raw_move / tick

# === DAILY RANGE IN TICKS ===
daily_range = src.h - src.l
range_ticks = daily_range / tick

# === CONTRACT NOTIONAL ===
notional = close * multiplier

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='Daily Range in Ticks',
    category='Asset Spec'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=range_ticks)

cs_lines(
    title='Daily Move in Ticks (O-to-C)',
    category='Asset Spec'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=move_in_ticks)

cards(
    category='Asset Spec',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Asset Metadata', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Name', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Tick Size', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Multiplier', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Asset Class', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Exchange', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)((spec.name, spec.min_tick, spec.multiplier, spec.asset_class, spec.exchange))

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Range (ticks)', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
        ColumnSpec(title='Asset Class', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)((range_ticks, spec.asset_class))
